criteria.requirement: Add packaging.utils.build_wheel_filename(name,version,tags,build=()) and build_sdist_filename(name,version,extension=".tar.gz"). Validate/normalize project names and versions using existing APIs. Stable compressed tag components must parse back to the EXACT supplied Tag set; reject non-Cartesian sets instead of inventing compatibility. Validate build tuple and exact roundtrip, reject empty tags and invalid suffix/components. Sdist supports tar.gz/zip, canonical underscore escape. Never create/install archives or alter parsing permissiveness.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
